# Atlassian Support

> Official support documentation and troubleshooting resources for Atlassian products including Jira, Confluence, Advanced Roadmaps, and Atlassian Analytics.

This site provides comprehensive knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and configuration documentation for Atlassian's suite of collaboration and project management tools across Cloud, Data Center, and Server deployments.

## Key Topics

- Jira Software
- Confluence
- Advanced Roadmaps for Jira
- Atlassian Analytics
- Jira Service Management
- Data Center
- Cloud deployment
- Troubleshooting
- User management
- Admin permissions
- SAML SSO
- Dashboard templates
- Database queries
- License management

## Getting Started

- [Atlassian Support](https://support.atlassian.com): Main support hub for Jira, Confluence, and other Atlassian products

## Advanced Roadmaps Troubleshooting

- [Troubleshoot Missing Issues in Advanced Roadmaps for Jira Data Center](https://support.atlassian.com/advanced-roadmaps-for-jira/kb/troubleshoot-missing-issues-in-advanced-roadmaps-for-jira-data-center): Troubleshooting guide for missing issues in Advanced Roadmaps Data Center
- [Accessing Advanced Roadmaps plans in Jira Data Centre results in License Violation error message](https://support.atlassian.com/advanced-roadmaps-for-jira/kb/accessing-advanced-roadmaps-plans-in-jira-data-centre-results-in-license-violation-error-message): Fix License Violation error in Advanced Roadmaps for Jira Data Centre 8.15+
- [Cannot Create Advanced Roadmap Plan due to error Your plan contains more than 100 projects](https://support.atlassian.com/advanced-roadmaps-for-jira/kb/cannot-create-advanced-roadmap-plan-due-to-error-your-plan-contains-more-than-100-projects): Resolve 100 projects limit error and Lexorank issues in Jira Data Center
- [One of Advance Roadmap plan takes significantly longer time to load than the plan](https://support.atlassian.com/advanced-roadmaps-for-jira/kb/one-of-advance-roadmap-plan-takes-significantly-longer-time-to-load-than-the-plan): Optimize database indexes to improve slow Advanced Roadmap plan loading
- [Some resolved Jira issues are missing from Advanced Roadmaps programs](https://support.atlassian.com/advanced-roadmaps-for-jira/kb/some-resolved-jira-issues-are-missing-from-advanced-roadmaps-programs): Adjust Completion Date filter to show missing resolved issues in Programs
- [The value of date picker custom field is not shown on Advanced Roadmaps Plan](https://support.atlassian.com/advanced-roadmaps-for-jira/kb/the-value-of-date-picker-custom-field-is-not-shown-on-advanced-roadmaps-plan): Fix date picker custom field display by adjusting search template settings
- [Creating a Sample Plan in Advanced roadmap fails if the setting Allow unassigned issues is turned OFF](https://support.atlassian.com/advanced-roadmaps-for-jira/kb/creating-a-sample-plan-in-advanced-roadmap-fails-if-the-setting-allow-unassigned-issues-is-turned-off): Fix Sample Plan creation by enabling 'Allow unassigned issues' setting

## Advanced Roadmaps Configuration

- [How to change Advanced Roadmaps default view for all Jira users](https://support.atlassian.com/advanced-roadmaps-for-jira/kb/how-to-change-advanced-roadmaps-default-view-for-all-jira-users): Configure default view settings for Advanced Roadmaps across all users
- [Advanced Roadmap Plan - Create group to group by issue for custom field on the timeline](https://support.atlassian.com/advanced-roadmaps-for-jira/kb/advanced-roadmap-plan-create-group-to-group-by-issue-for-custom-field-on-the-timeline): Create custom field groups for timeline issue grouping in Jira Cloud

## Atlassian Analytics Setup & Features

- [Add Analytics to an existing site](https://support.atlassian.com/analytics/docs/add-atlassian-analytics-to-an-existing-site): Create Analytics workspace and connect to existing Atlassian site
- [Additional features](https://support.atlassian.com/analytics/docs/additional-features): Overview of Analytics features: AI SQL, custom tables, performance monitoring
- [Add or remove columns](https://support.atlassian.com/analytics/docs/add-or-remove-columns): Manage columns in Analytics visual mode queries using schema browser
- [Add or remove query filters](https://support.atlassian.com/analytics/docs/add-or-remove-query-filters): Filter Analytics query results using visual mode filter operators
- [Archive, delete, or restore a dashboard](https://support.atlassian.com/analytics/docs/archive-delete-or-restore-a-dashboard): Manage Analytics dashboards: archive, delete, or restore from trash

## Analytics Dashboard Templates

- ["Adoption" dashboard template](https://support.atlassian.com/analytics/docs/adoption-dashboard-template): Confluence usage tracking dashboard template for team adoption metrics
- ["Alert MTTA/C statistics of teams" dashboard template](https://support.atlassian.com/analytics/docs/alert-mtta-c-statistics-of-teams-dashboard-template): Dashboard template for tracking team alert response MTTA/MTTC metrics

## Optional

- [Bullet chart settings](https://support.atlassian.com/analytics/docs/bullet-chart-settings): Customize bullet chart visualizations in Analytics dashboards
- [Change when you receive email notifications for comments](https://support.atlassian.com/analytics/docs/change-when-you-receive-email-notifications-for-comments): Configure email notification settings for Analytics chart/dashboard comments
